test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six people are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. P, O and T are seated in the same row facing South. A, E and R are seated in the same row facing North. E sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite T. A sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite O. (Persons facing south are exactly opposite to persons facing north)

Who sits at the centre of the row of people facing South?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. E sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83976dbe5fbf9694e18a67de7db3c7484be3ac046bf899080019b51203a4850f.png] 

2. A sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1736fc9253b1ca01ff058ab14d9360e46f5d0e32c913835aa26f97c89ff4914.png] 

Here, **P** is sitting in the middle and facing south.

Hence, the correct answer is "P".
